title: Solving CDU Flow Measurement Challenges with Electromagnetic Technology
summary: Learn how electromagnetic flow meters address CDU challenges with accurate flow measurement, flexible installation and reliable performance in liquid-cooled data centers.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)


The ModMAG M2000 combines accurate electromagnetic flow measurement with installation flexibility, bidirectional measurement, diagnostic capabilities and communication options suited to modern CDU control and monitoring requirements.


A Coolant Distribution Unit (CDU) transfers heat between liquid-cooled IT equipment and the facility cooling infrastructure. CDUs help regulate coolant flow, temperature and pressure to support reliable operation of high-density computing environments.


Yes. CDU systems commonly use conductive water-glycol mixtures that are compatible with electromagnetic flow measurement technologies.


Several factors can influence flow measurement performance, including limited installation space, variable flow rates, electromagnetic interference (EMI) and integration requirements with building automation or cooling control systems.


Engineers should evaluate factors such as measurement accuracy, installation flexibility, compatibility with cooling fluids, communication capabilities, maintenance requirements and performance in electrically noisy environments.
